answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to work in talent representation as an agent or manager, building lasting relationships with artists and helping guide their careers across film, television, and other media.
answers.drew: I have always been drawn to the relationship-driven and creative sides of storytelling, as well as the power of art to affect people and create meaningful change. I am especially interested in representation and in helping artists develop their voices, build their careers, and bring important stories to audiences.
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with people who share my passion for storytelling and are also entering the entertainment industry. I would also love to connect with professionals who can offer advice and guidance as I begin building my career.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is my mother, who produces animated films and has always emphasized the importance of Asian and multicultural representation. Watching her create stories in which young people can see themselves reflected on screen has shown me how powerful entertainment can be and has deeply shaped my own interest in the industry.
